educationalGoal:
-To gain the basic skills needed in processes from finding problems to solutions.
-To understand phenomena, objectives, and events quantitatively and qualitatively.
-To be able to find characteristics and laws of phenomena, objectives, and events.
-To be able to deliver the above information to a third person intelligibly.
-To gain various basic skills to proceed smoothly with verification activities.
-To be able to have a picture of technology fields and engineers of discipline.
advice:
In this course, to achieve the above educational goals, the students will learn basic skills required for verification and problem-solving processes. This course will deal with characteristic things of the corresponding department.
In the Department of Information and Computer Science and the Department of Artificial Intelligence, students learn data processing skills for discrete data and continuous data.

[1st part: processing discrete data]
Students learn how to process discrete data, especially text data, manually or using Python. First, students individually practice processing a small amount of text data. Then, they practice team building by applying the PBL method.

[2nd part: processing continuous data]
Students learn how to process continuous data from IoT devices such as microcomputers and sensors. First, students practice processing data from microcomputers such as temperature, distance, etc. Then, they try to develop a “toy” that is convenient for daily life as a team by applying the PBL method.
